text: Friendly stay. Good mattress, good shower. Lack of microwave oven to warm up milk.

Simple, easy going and convinient. A relaxed stay that is well enough placed for a quick jump into town on the metro. The breakfast is worth it to. For those wanting to go into town via public transport, you may a bit of a walk to the nearest metro station. An extra plug point at the bed would be nice.

Great location, amazing views! Great location, great views of Wanaka Lake and the mountain ranges - it was gorgeous and we got a beautiful sunrise view which we loved. Great restaurant downstairs and very close to lots of food places and shops. Modern room with a nice balcony and fresh bathroom. Was really good! Walls are a little thin, we could hear our neighbours voices (a little muffled) and we could hear when our neighbours flushed their toilets.
nice food at the pub and a game of darts no air conditioner

Hotel on a busy street. Location is a main point but on the other hand hotel located on a very busy street. Our room window was just above the entrance. It was very noisy till late night. My recommendation if you choose this hotel ask a room with window on opposite side. Noisy street.
Food was excellent breakfast and dinner had a vast variety. Service of the staff was good. Room was smaller than we expected

Comfy and enjoyable stay. Beds were amazing, staff friendly, rooms spacious and well equipped Cleanliness could have been slightly better. Continental breakfast was a bit of an embarrassment. Also someone using our room to put a meal on which meant a member of staff chased us out to take payment. To stop mistakes like this i think meals shoud be paid for at the time

Well located, cleaner rooms but toilets could definitely improve. The property was well located inside fort, staff were very accommodating and friendly. The rooms were clean with comfortable beds. The rooms didn’t have any ventilation/open windows. The bathroom - there was not enough space between the shower, the sink and the commode. There was also no partition between the shower area so the whole toilet would get wet.

Was a nice hotel room to relax after a tiring day. Location was very close to City Hall Subway station, bus stations are around 300M walk. ROom was clean and got cleaned everyday during our stay. 2 7-11 nearby , GS store 200 meters away, Emart 150 away.
clean, affordable price.
Big room with locker, many restrooms and showers, everything was clean. Staying was pretty anonymous.

Enjoyable. The room was very comfortable, breakfast was really tasty with a good choice. The staff made the hotel, everyone we interacted with were very friendly and pleasant. The queue to get into the bar area

Boa vista review. The staff especially Alex were super friendly and helpful in so many ways including recommendations for various things. Exceptional view from the lounge area too. Breakfast had a large and lovely selection of fruits and meats and supplied gluten free toast Plenty of fresh towels and toiletries and room made up every day Location was perfect at the outskirts of the old town and a very short walk to the beautiful Marina with so much fun things to offer Mattress and pillows were uncomfortable Hot breakfast wasn't great but was glad of the boiled eggs Pool was lovely and clean I'm sure but the dirty stained wall around it was a bit of an eyesore unfortunately
We will be back to a Haus establishment when we return to Adelaide - like Haus Mannum & Lodge. Close to restaurants and shops. Great mattress

Great for a quick getaway! Beautiful location, only 15 min or so walk into town (or quick $1 trolly ride). Loved that they had both pool and lake chairs. Clean room with very comfortable beds. Staff were always very helpful. Bathroom was fine but is very ready for an upgrade. Would be great if they had a room to store luggage before/after checking in/out.
Nice family hotel. Spacious room with nice breakfast and private parking. Far from the center o Oia.
Good location. Parking is an added bonus. Good breakfast with plenty of choice. Rarely got a WiFi connection.
Breakfast, room space Complimentary excess to bar should be provided for booking above 5 nights

Nice hotel. Good location. Good price. Breakfast was good. Room was good. Had a good sleep Poor service in the bar Sunday evening. We finished our main course and no-one collected our plates. After 50 mins I asked for a desert menu. We got one but no one came to take an order so I paid at the bar and we left and returned to our room.

Excellent stay, staff, but noisy room and might not use booking.com. The hotel is excellent! Staff is amazing!!! Room is excellent too, but the freeway noise is very disturbing. Also, the neighbors were very noisy with the tv on in loud volume since 6am. Hilton honors does not consider points booked on 3rd party website. I had no idea about that. Seems Booking.com booked my room that had the freeway on the back, and it was the most noisy place. I will return to Hampton to stay as I loved the hotel room (other than the noise), and especially the staff. But, I might not book through Booking.com because of the above reasons. Noise noise noise - freeway and neighbors. Hilton honors does not consider points if booking through 3rd party websites.

Cleaning was very good, every day cleaning of rooms. Location perfect. Free access to spa means 1 hour only access free. Spa was not so good 20° and hamam also. Rooms was not like in the pictures, it was small.

Our stay was not bad at all.For the price you need to up your game. The location is very good- central. The welcome was very warm and no hassle at check in. The room looks exactly like it is in the pictures. Stayed on 3rd floor. No noise issue. Very clean No telephones in room so you need to go down to receptions if you need assistance. No slippers/ gown. Floors are cold especially after a nice warm shower. How about rug on both side of bed. Why only 1 chair. Clearly a deluxe room should have at least 2 chairs. How about having a guide to navigate hotel services -brochure

Beautiful Area close to the sea. The Location of the guesthouse is very good to visit the national park. The huts are easy and clean The Kitchen for all people was in a bad condition. But in some cases it depends on the behaviour of the other guest. Nevertheless I would recommend to invest here to get a better Overall Situation
Staff very friendly and helpful. Breakfast good , room look old but clean and comfort bed , location ok The room look old but faciliti all good
Outstanding value for money with the best views of KL. The pool was also unforgetable. Incredible views and comfortable bed. Arrived very late so the checking experience was extremely difficult.
i only stayed one night. I watched the tv. clean and comfortable and a great breakfast n/à
incredible value, worked just right for our road trip north. great bedding combination for us, lovely kitchenette facilities. ---
Amazing value for money. Friendly staff. amazing value for money

Great location, comfort and price. We loved this hotel. It had three beautiful pools, kind staff, comfortable room, close to the beach and all the various restaurants. I read a bunch of reviews that mentioned the rooms smell - the room does occasionally have a smell, but that's just because of the humidify (remember, this is Thailand). It really never bothered us. The breakfast was actually really good (I had eggs, rice, chicken, fresh fruit, nice cup of coffee). It's true that the gym is small and not very functional, but who cares. There is a fantastic Muay Thai gym called Khun Suek within walking distance. We stayed for a week, then extended our stay for another 10 days. I wish the concierge knew how to call a taxi. I needed to get somewhere in the city, the concierge told me to go out into the street and find a TukTuk rather than just picking up the phone and calling a taxi to the hotel.
Clean, comfortable. Great location

A great apartment at a very reasonable price. Location is not the best. We loved the apartment - it is exactly as shown on the pictures. The host met us and directed us to the parking space. He then proceeded to show us how to use the codes to get into the building and our apartment. He was very accommodating. The apartment has everything needed for a short stay. The apartment is located in a part of town that even locals told us is not safe. I was traveling with my teen daughter, and walking to the subway station (located 10 minutes from the apartment) did not feel safe in broad daylight. In the evenings we were advised to not walk around in the neighborhood, and since I didn't want to drive in Athens, we were using taxis to get home from downtown. The location is the only reason I am not giving the apartment a rating of 10
Very central but not noisy. Very comfortable and well appointed.
I was travelling with elderly parents in a wheelchair and the porter assisted with the baggage to and from train and gave us all the assistance we needed to make it very easy for us
Great location and value for the price. It fit our family of 5 in one room and the staff was friendly. Although they had WiFi we could never get it to work.
Everything was great, clean, decent beds, clean facility. They were a Days Inn before changing names, and they need to get a light up sign we arrived after dark.
We will be back. The room the pool and the price
Good money for value. Convenient, by the airport. Private and no one bothered me for the evening. Lock One of the sheets had stains on it
The location was perfect - on a lovely beach which wasn’t too busy. The pool area of the resort was also amazing. Although it was in a quieter location, I was still kept awake one night by loud music
Clean, friendly staff, convenient location, WiFi, bar, restaurant, etc. Chair in room too low.
Breakfast was really good, staff was helpful and the overall facilities were clean Shower was a little bit small, there were some annoying mosquitoes, which made sleeping time somehow troublesome
nice relaxing getaway. amazing views, quiet and good sized rooms Shower design needs fixing, water pours out everywhere as glass screen is too short.
The bar and the pool
excellent host :) Nice, peaceful area, even at the beach was not crowded, easy to go to Barcelona by train, Would like to stay again :)
Good value. Lean and comfortable and conveniently located No comments

This is our third stay at Sofitel Gatwick. And every time we feel the benefit of our stay. Thank you. We had breakfast delivered to our room, that arrived on time and was plentiful. We had forgotten to order coffee and room service rang before delivery to confirm and we had coffee with our breakfast. Nice touch thank you. A major shout out for Jake who was a star. The minute we walked through the door looking for a trolley for our many suitcases he took over and ensured we got to the reception and that we had everything we needed he was there promptly the following morning to collect our baggage and take it to reception for us to book out. We were impressed with the way he conducted himself and how proactive he was was in his job. He is a credit to the management. Thank you Jake. No robes. But not a major problem.

A comfortable and quiet place to stay. It was an overall comfortable and pleasant stay. The location is great, the area is nice, and the property is easy to find. Very welcoming and helpful staff. I made a mistake in stating my arrival time as early morning hours instead of daytime, and even though I didn't notice the error till the last moment, the staff sent me correspondence and tried to accommodate my request in a caring and polite manner. I was staying in the smallest room, which was clear upon booking, but it was big enough for a solo traveler and very comfortable. The single bed was wide and very cozy. The room was very quiet and I had a good night sleep. There was a spacious full-size shower, a desk, and a closet space to store luggage and clothing out of the way. Ideal for a short stay in busy and very expensive Dublin. Nothing to mention.

Choice of cooked foods offered, for breakfast, and excellent choice of fresh fruits, and locally produced marmalades/jams. Availability of parking. Proximity to esplanade and town, within walking distance.
Room was great, blinds were great on keeping the morning light out. Bathroom was nice with the shower shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided. No pancake machine 😢
